Monthly Sales — Calendar Year Comparison
Monthly Net Revenue — 2024 / 2025 / 2026
Shaded area per year — 2026 YTD Mar–May only
What this shows: Net monthly sales for each calendar year — gross invoices minus credit notes, in millions of Rand (R M on the vertical axis).
How to read it: Each coloured area represents one year. The yellow area is 2026 (current year, March–May only). The lighter blue area is 2025. The faint dashed area is 2024 (the baseline). A taller area means more revenue in that month. Where the yellow 2026 area sits above the blue 2025 area, the business is ahead of the prior year for that month.
YOY Growth % by Calendar Month
Blue = 2025 vs 2024 · Coloured = 2026 vs 2025 · Dashed line = 30% target
What this shows: How much revenue grew (or declined) compared to the same month in the prior year, expressed as a percentage.
How to read it: Each month has two bars. The steel-blue bar shows how 2025 performed against 2024. The coloured bar shows how 2026 is performing against 2025. Bar colour signals performance — green means the 30% growth target was exceeded, amber means the business grew but fell short of target, and red means revenue declined versus the prior year. The dashed yellow line marks the 30% growth target. Bars only appear for months where data exists.

Credit Notes — Reason Analysis

Every CRNOTE row, classified by reason. Filter by FY or rep to see what is driving credits in each slice.

Data range: 04 Mar 2024 → 06 Aug 2026
Period
Rep
Reason capture started FY2025. Pre-FY2025 credits had no reason recorded; where the prodname carries the reason (e.g. COMMISSION, TRANSPORT RECOVERY) it is back-inferred, everything else falls into UNSPECIFIED. The Reason capture % KPI shows how well the slice is annotated.
